name.zh: 赤座公开一辉与史黛菈绯闻

periods.summary: Akaza arrives with newspapers carrying a photo of Ikki and Stella kissing, alongside fabricated claims that Ikki is immoral and dangerous. He invokes the Ethics Committee to take Ikki to an investigation meeting.
periods.cause: Akaza and the Kurogane side need a pretext to challenge Ikki's knight qualification before he reaches Seven Stars.
periods.process: Akaza insults Ikki, ignores Toka's objections, shows the papers, and frames the royal romance as an international scandal. Stella denounces the stories as lies, but Akaza says refusal to attend would worsen Ikki's position.
periods.outcome: Ikki accepts the summons and is taken into Ethics Committee custody.
periods.significance: Turns Ikki and Stella's private romance into the main political weapon of the volume.
